title: BGG single-source Lorentzian parent admission after the Phase 15R frozen-census failure
registration_scope: This is a source-scoped reproduction and parent-admission cycle. It tests one newly scoped primary-source candidate, Binétruy-Girardi-Grimm hep-th/0005225v1, without importing Hohl, Kallosh, Kugo, ADM, or textbook conventions into its source-formula derivation. Contract-fixed geometry, domain, unit bridges, and comparison targets are explicitly non-evidential specification nodes rather than facts attributed to BGG. All design-stage observations are disclosed as known priors. The cycle ends at source eligibility and cannot evaluate homogeneous supersymmetry tangency, canonical closure, a physical supercharge, temporal branches, or the Temporal-Folded SUSY ontology.

items: BGG hep-th/0005225v1 presents itself as a self-contained Kähler-superspace construction of minimal D=4 N=1 supergravity coupled to chiral matter and gives explicit component transformations and a complete auxiliary-retaining component action.
BGG Appendix A uses eta_ab=diag(-1,+1,+1,+1). Section 4 defines the Lorentz curvature two-form, the scalar contraction calR=e_a^n e_b^m (R_nm)^{ab}, and the component action with -calR/2.

The sign-rejected Hohl v1 candidate instead printed the final Lorentz pair in the reverse order, e_a^n e_b^m (R_nm)^{ba}, while retaining -calR/2. The exact antisymmetric-pair order difference was observed before this contract and is not a discovery outcome of Phase 16A.

By comparison with the already reproduced Hohl branch, the anticipated BGG source-native FLRW result is R_BGG=-6Q, raw Einstein Lagrangian +dot(B)-3C, and one-negative/two-positive first-order inertia. This anticipation must be reproduced or refuted from the BGG source AST rather than inserted.

BGG explicitly prints the old-minimal fields M, Mbar, b_a; the chiral fields A, chi, F and conjugates; their local supersymmetry transformations; the auxiliary-uneliminated matter D-term; and the full supergravity-plus-matter component action. The anticipated coverage status is complete formula-family availability, not a proof of a future homogeneous truncation.

Kugo-Yokokura-Yoshioka arXiv:1602.04441v2 is not an active candidate here. In the strict W=0 Phase 15-style fieldwise component gate, its detailed Poincaré component compensation formulas live on the W nonzero G=K+ln|W|^2 patch; the W=0 completion is inferable but not fully displayed and is therefore a known SOURCE_INCOMPLETE alternative under this contract's stricter rule.

The anticipated aggregate is that BGG becomes FULL_OFFSHELL_ELIGIBLE for a later separately preregistered tangency attempt. That anticipation has zero novelty weight and cannot be reported as a SUSY or cosmological result.

Only an independent replay may ratify that classification as the final Phase 16A result. A match ratifies source reproducibility only and has novelty REPRODUCTION.

scope_lock.matter: One neutral chiral multiplet with source Kähler metric g_{A Abar}=1, no vectors or gauging, and W identically zero. For dimensionful comparison set Phi=M_P A=(T+iY)/sqrt(2), K=Phi Phibar/M_P^2, with M_P>0. This is a positive real unit bridge, not a source-sign repair.

frozen_decision.enum_authority: classification_policy.candidate_status_axis is the sole candidate-status enum authority.

symbolic_provenance_policy.BGG_SOURCE: Only formulas, coefficients, index orderings, fields, and transformations printed in the frozen BGG v1 archive may carry this tag.
symbolic_provenance_policy.CONTRACT_FIXED: The metric ansatz, positive domain, V_0, M_P, N, a, Q, B, C, X, T, Y, the positive field-unit bridge, and target Hamiltonian carry this non-evidential tag.
symbolic_provenance_policy.allowed_edge: A CONTRACT_FIXED leaf may enter a BGG_SOURCE node only as a substitution, domain restriction, or unit bridge. It may not provide or repair a missing BGG coefficient, sign, index ordering, field, action term, or transformation.
symbolic_provenance_policy.comparison_boundary: Computed immutable BGG terminal records may be compared with CONTRACT_FIXED target records only in a non-symbolic decision layer that cannot become a derivation parent.
symbolic_provenance_policy.forbidden: Every other tag, foreign formula parent, mixed-source algebraic parent, or reverse edge from a BGG result into a contract-fixed target is invalid source stacking.

decision_input_axes.exact_compatibility_rule: EXACT_COMPATIBLE requires a rank-three Hessian with inertia (one negative, zero null, two positive) and exact equality to the frozen target Hamiltonian in the declared N,V_0,M_P,X,T,Y representative immediately after the single preregistered velocity-dependent endpoint and before any further dF(q,t)/dt, real point map, positive densitization, or positive overall rescaling. Any exact Hessian degeneracy, inertia mismatch, Hamiltonian coefficient/sign mismatch, or failure of that frozen normalization is EXACT_INCOMPATIBLE. Subsequent regular endpoints, point maps, and positive rescalings are inertia-only witnesses and cannot repair the Hamiltonian test.
decision_input_axes.coverage_axis_disjointness: EXACT_COMPLETE means every provenance-valid frozen coverage predicate is exactly true. EXACT_INCOMPLETE means the complete verified archive and registered locators exactly establish at least one required field, action, or transformation formula is absent, auxiliary-eliminated, or only delegated to an external citation. SOURCE_GAP means the archive and packet are provenance-valid but a preregistered unresolved typography, truncated member, or nonlocal dependency leaves a required proposition genuinely undecidable under the frozen source policy; it is neither a proved absence nor unfinished implementation. A missing prereg packet hash, required locator, version, or declared caveat is instead PREREG_OR_PROVENANCE_INVALID and never SOURCE_GAP. UNCONSTRUCTED means the requisite provenance-valid source material is present but the registered calculation or verification was not completed. The executable may not invent a new SOURCE_GAP after seeing the outcome.
decision_input_axes.bosonic_axis_disjointness: EXACT_COMPATIBLE and EXACT_INCOMPATIBLE are complete exact outcomes. SOURCE_GAP has the same narrow provenance-valid-but-undecidable meaning as above for a bosonic source proposition. Missing prereg source controls are invalid, while an unfinished derivation with available source material is UNCONSTRUCTED.

frozen_decision.invalid_application_rule: Preflight collects all detectable invalid events before any curvature or science calculation, then applies the highest listed qualification separately to each affected target. An invalid event first detected during a derivation stops that derivation and every downstream calculation immediately. It does not retroactively invalidate an unaffected target with an already immutable complete record, except where invalid_event_table explicitly applies the event to both targets.

machine_decision_table.input: bosonic_derivation_status=EXACT_INCOMPATIBLE, including an exact degenerate Hessian, wrong inertia, or wrong target Hamiltonian

artifact_order: In a second pre-result commit freeze PHASE16A_SOURCE_CONVENTION_PACKET.json with official archive/file hashes, exact labels, source AST rules, typography caveats, field inventory, and semantic mutants.
In a third commit add the complete phase16a_bgg_parent_admission.py executable. Static review is allowed; import, compile, or execution is forbidden before this commit.
Run the committed executable for the first time and persist PHASE16A_RUN_RESULT.json in a later commit.
Perform an independent read-only replay and persist PHASE16A_REPLAY_RECEIPT.json in another commit.
Only then write PHASE16A_BGG_PARENT_ADMISSION.md and update README/STATUS.
frozen_decision.sequencing_rule: Phase 16A stops at parent admission. Even FULL_OFFSHELL_ELIGIBLE only permits consideration of a new separately preregistered Bianchi-I-first tangency cycle.
